gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the Statement of Activities - Modified Cash Basis (pp2-3): charges for services 1,884,283 (Electric 1,172,715, Water 301,337, Sewer 303,112, Garbage 107,119) + operating grants 10,000 + investment income 653 + miscellaneous income 3,153 = 1,898,089. Detail comes from the Proprietary Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7): total operating revenues 1,870,911 (charges 1,857,758 + grants 10,000 + misc 3,153) + investment income 653 = 1,871,564. The whole gap is charges for services: 1,884,283 - 1,857,758 = 26,525 (Electric 1,172,715 vs 1,149,229 = 23,486; Water 301,337 vs 300,159 = 1,178; Sewer 303,112 vs 301,895 = 1,217; Garbage 107,119 vs 106,475 = 644). Two printed statements on different measurement bases; every p7 line is already in detail; no fix.

Statement total 1,677,862 is the Statement of Activities - Modified Cash Basis (p2): Electric 1,023,109 + Water 217,867 + Sewer 123,780 + Garbage 88,427 + debt principal 200,000 + interest and fees 24,679. Detail is the proprietary funds statement (p7): purchased services 802,370 + total operating expenses 774,572 (incl. depreciation 186,243) + interest and fees 23,773 = 1,600,715. The fund statement includes depreciation and excludes the 200,000 debt principal (and prints interest 23,773 vs 24,679); different printed bases; every p7 line is already in detail; no fix.
